rows.grounds: past passive participle describing afflicted beings

items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the group in question.
That count is placed among thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings located there are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousands of womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams contain tormented beings.
